This table is the **soil-moisture application module** that sits on top of the
25-item paper checklist (@or-metadata). It does not repeat UAV platform,
flight, or geodetic fields.

Parameters marked **Mandatory (M)** are the minimum for a soil-moisture paper.
**Quantitative (Q)** and **Full (F)** remain listed for completeness of the
module; they are not required in every article.

**Table 11. Soil Moisture Target Application and Ground-Truth Parameters**

| Parameter / Metadata Key | Standard Origin / Citation | Importance Level | Data Type / Format | Examples (Value Pattern / Controlled Vocabulary) | Detailed Parameter Description & Methodological Function |
| :--- | :--- | :---: | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1. Soil Water Content Target Variables** | | | | | |
| `soil_water_content_type` | OpenSkyLab; Du2024; Heistermann2023 | **Mandatory (M)** | Categorical | `volumetric_VWC` \| `gravimetric_GWC` \| `degree_of_saturation` \| `matric_potential` | Physical formulation of soil moisture. Volumetric Water Content (VWC) is mandatory for optical/thermal remote sensing scaling. |
| `soil_moisture_value_unit` | Dopper2022; Heistermann2023 | **Mandatory (M)** | String | `m3/m3` \| `vol_%` \| `g/g` \| `wt_%` \| `kPa` \| `hPa` | Physical unit of target soil moisture values represented in ground samples and predicted raster pixels. |
| `measurement_depth_layer` | Chu2026; Farhad2025; Heistermann2023 | **Mandatory (M)** | String (cm) | `0-2.5` \| `0-5` \| `0-20` \| `20-40` \| `0-60` | Vertical soil layer depth of measurement. Crucial for identifying optical surface sensing vs. root-zone hydrologic decoupling. |

| Parameter / Metadata Key | Standard Origin / Citation | Importance Level | Data Type / Format | Examples (Value Pattern / Controlled Vocabulary) | Detailed Parameter Description & Methodological Function |

| **2. In-Situ Reference & Ground-Truth Protocol** | | | | | |
| `insitu_reference_method` | Du2024; Farhad2025; Heistermann2023; Bhatti2020 | **Mandatory (M)** | Categorical | `thermo_gravimetric_oven_105C` \| `capacitance_FDR` \| `TDR_impedance` \| `CRNS_neutron_probe` \| `GNSS_R` | Ground-truth reference measurement technology used for model training and independent validation. |
| `insitu_sensor_calibration` | Dopper2022; Heistermann2023; Senyurek2022 | **Quantitative (Q)** | Categorical | `factory_default` \| `site_specific_soil_curve` \| `Topp_equation` \| `mineral_soil_standard` | Conversion equation applied to translate raw soil dielectric permittivity / frequency into volumetric moisture. |
| `sampling_time_lag_offset` | He2026; Dopper2022; Zhuang2023 | **Mandatory (M)** | Float (minutes) | `0.0` (simultaneous) \| `15.0` \| `60.0` \| `120.0` | Time lag \\(\Delta t\\) between UAV overpass and ground soil sampling. Minimizes errors from rapid diurnal evaporation/irrigation. |
| `sampling_spatial_scheme` | Heistermann2023; Du2024; Zhuang2023 | **Full (F)** | Categorical | `grid_sampling` \| `random_replicates` \| `transect` \| `stratified_plots` | Spatial sampling design deployed across the field to capture intra-field soil moisture spatial autocorrelation. |
| `sample_replicates_count` | Heistermann2023; Dopper2022 | **Quantitative (Q)** | Integer (\\(N\\)) | `3` \| `5` \| `10` | Number of sub-sample core/probe replicates taken within a pixel radius and averaged to account for micro-spatial variance. |

| **3. Soil Physical & Hydrophysical Matrix** | | | | | |
| `soil_texture_class_usda` | Du2024; Dopper2022; Heistermann2023 | **Mandatory (M)** | Categorical / Array | `loam` \| `sandy_loam` \| `clay_loam` \| `[sand_%, silt_%, clay_%]` | Soil particle size distribution according to USDA taxonomy. Governs soil dielectric behavior and hydraulic capacity. |
| `soil_bulk_density` | Du2024; Heistermann2023; Zhang2023 | **Mandatory (M)** | Float (\\(\text{g/cm}^3\\)) | `1.35` \| `1.44` \| `1.52` | Dry soil bulk density (\\(\rho_b\\)). Essential mathematical multiplier for converting gravimetric water content (\\(GWC\\)) to volumetric (\\(VWC\\)). |
| `soil_organic_matter_content` | Heistermann2023; Farhad2025 | **Full (F)** | Float (%) | `1.8` \| `2.5` \| `4.1` | Soil Organic Matter / Carbon (SOM / SOC % via Loss-on-Ignition LOI). Influences background soil spectral absorption and bound water. |
| `soil_surface_roughness` | Chakhar2021; Farhad2025; Senyurek2022 | **Full (F)** | Array (cm) | `h_rms: 1.2 cm, L: 8.5 cm` | Surface roughness parameters (\\(RMS\\) height \\(h_{rms}\\), correlation length \\(L\\)). Mandatory for radar, GNSS-R, and optical BRDF scattering. |
| `soil_hydraulic_limits` | Du2024; Dopper2022 | **Full (F)** | Array (\\(\text{m}^3/\text{m}^3\\)) | `FC: 0.357, PWP: 0.124` | Hydrophysical soil constants: Field Capacity (\\(FC\\)) and Permanent Wilting Point (\\(PWP\\)). Defines plant-available water thresholds. |

| **4. Vegetation Canopy & Interferences** | | | | | |
| `fractional_vegetation_cover` | Zhang2023; Chakhar2021; Yin2024 | **Quantitative (Q)** | Float (0–1) | `0.15` \| `0.45` \| `0.85` | Fractional Vegetation Cover (\\(FVC\\) / \\(FC\\)). Used for soil background decomposition and Water Cloud Model (WCM) parametrization. |
| `leaf_area_index` | Dopper2022; Shi2025; Yin2024 | **Quantitative (Q)** | Float (\\(\text{m}^2/\text{m}^2\\)) | `0.6` \| `1.2` \| `2.5` | Leaf Area Index (\\(LAI\\)). Defines validity thresholds for optical soil sensing (e.g., \\(LAI < 0.75\\) in PROSAIL hybrid models). |
| `vegetation_water_content` | Senyurek2022; Farhad2025 | **Full (F)** | Float (\\(\text{kg/m}^2\\)) | `0.25` \| `0.80` \| `1.50` | Canopy Vegetation Water Content (\\(VWC_{veg}\\)). Used to correct microwave attenuation and canopy scattering in GNSS-R/Radar. |
| `crop_phenology_stage` | Chu2026; Chakhar2021; Chen2024 | **Quantitative (Q)** | Categorical / BBCH | `BBCH 12 (leaf dev)` \| `BBCH 30 (jointing)` \| `BBCH 65 (flowering)` | Crop phenological growth stage. Accounts for canopy closure, root development, and spectral saturation effects. |
